title: Potato, Zucchini & Kidney Bean Bake with Avocado Pico de Gallo

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Quarter potatoes and transfer to a large baking sheet pan; drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until potatoes start to soften, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans; place in a large bowl.
Trim and large dice zucchini; add to the bowl with the beans. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to combine.
When the potatoes have softened, remove from oven; add beans and zucchini to the baking sheet. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until veggies are fork-tender, 10-12 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lime into the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the lime juice.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Small dice tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the pico de gallo.
To serve, divide roasted veggies and beans between plates or bowls; top with yogurt and pico de gallo. Enjoy!
